diagnosis: AsyncReportExportStatusView allows any authenticated user to query Redis Queue job status by job_id without checking if job.meta['user_id'] or job.meta['tenant_id'] matches the requesting user. When an export job finishes, the endpoint leaks pre-signed S3 download URLs containing financial ledgers, salary audits, or customer PII generated by other accounts.
